title: EMOSA virtual agent status
description: STATE_DIR/status.json, rewritten at least once a second while anything changes. Read-only for observers; never contains secrets.

pod.description: What the agent currently reports about the pod; null while the pod is unavailable.

observed_channel.description: The fronthaul radio's channel as the pod's Wifi_Radio_State shows it; null without one.

channel_mismatch.description: The radio is up on another channel than the one reported.

backhaul.description: The pod's EasyMesh backhaul STA (option 1), as reported to the controller; null over OpenSync's GRE (option 2).

pod_refused.description: spec 3.10: SCHEMA_MISMATCH while the connected pod's schema is not its profile's generation (a 6.6 profile on a legacy pod, or the other way round): nothing is read from it or written to it.

reconnections.description: spec 2.5: the pod's new database generations that continued its source (a provisioned session kept) and those that were another source (a fresh session), by reason.

config_lost.description: kept reconnections whose pod no longer had the configuration: the session ended at once, the fresh session's M2 writing it

start_marker.description: spec 3.10: a legacy pod's start marker (EMOSA's Node_Config row emosa/start); absent on a 6.6 pod. Unmarked, the pod is not ready for any scope until a write takes.

on.description: false: the pod's schema has no Node_Config, its starts counted by the agent's sessions

pending_since.description: since when (Unix time) the pod's database has had no marker; null while it has one

last_error.description: why the agent's last write of a marker failed (its reason, and the database's error where it gave one, as OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: constraint violation for a full table); null before one failed

session.description: The onboarding session: state, counters and recent events.

radio_operations.description: Spec 9: each further radio's own scope, by band ("5G"): its operations, each made from that radio's own M2 set; bsses are the SSIDs its slots map (none: its slot VIFs removed). Empty for a profile with one radio.

uplink.description: The uplink scope: data plane option 1, or a wired pod's Ethernet uplink (mode ethernet). mode off: the agent leaves the pod's uplink alone.

mode.description: Absent with multi-ap; ethernet: a wired pod's uplink bridged into br-home (spec §8.4).

bridge.description: With ethernet: the bridge the port's Connection_Manager_Uplink row names.

uplink.description: multi-ap, or the if_type of the uplink cm uses (gre, eth, vif).

bssid.description: The upstream backhaul BSS the station is pinned to.

parent.description: The BSS the station is on (lower case).

held.description: Held on option 2 and why; EMOSA does not switch this pod again until it is admitted anew.

waiting.description: Why no switch is being made; "kept target waiting for its parent" while a kept target's fleet pod has its AP down (spec §8.3).

kept.description: A kept backhaul target on another fleet pod (spec §8.3): its switches failed with that pod's AP up, its retry, and its wait for that AP (wall-clock seconds).

telemetry.description: The telemetry scope and the pod's own statistics as measured (spec §3.6). Absent fields stay absent: nothing is filled in.

steering.description: The client steering scope (spec §3.7): its counters, the open window and the latest outcomes.

gre_parent.description: A GRE parent's tunnels to its children (spec 8.6); for a former parent (withdrawn) the removal of the tunnels left on its former parent AP; null when the pod is neither.

ap_bssid.description: The parent AP's own BSSID; a child reads the fleet's parent set from it (spec 8.6). Null for a former parent.

withdrawn.description: A former parent: its profile is no longer a GRE parent, so it has no children.

gtp_station.description: A legacy pod's station on the site's GTP BSS (spec 3.10), with uplink.bootstrap; null without. Never the passphrase.

present.description: The station has a row, whoever wrote it.

joined.description: wm shows the station (its Wifi_VIF_State row).

radio_plan.description: A legacy pod's radio plan (spec 3.10), with profile radio_plan emosa; null without.

dark_radios.description: The profile's idle radios that carry an enabled AP while their state shows them off or with no channel (the plan turns them on).

node_config.description: The pod's modules' settings and reports (spec 4, the pods' modules), with modules configured; null without.

events_prev.description: The module's events before the pod's last boot, as its own log on flash has them.

probe_watch.description: The stations whose probe requests the pod watches (spec §3.9); null without telemetry.

ap_up.description: Each AP of the pod the agent has seen (and its GRE parent APs), true while enabled in the pod's Wifi_VIF_State on its current start with the report source live (spec §8.3): a fleet child whose kept backhaul target it is waits for it.
